title: Add RAG CLI slim-starter with live telemetry probes and contract hooks
author: Elena Morales
description:
Motivation: provide a minimal, opinionated CLI-based RAG quickstart for engineers who want a tiny, reproducible local development loop that includes lightweight telemetry probes, contract lint hooks for tool-calling schemas, and a compact smoke harness usable in CI. This quickstart targets teams that prefer a CLI-first workflow (no devcontainer required) and need a small surface area to run RAG scenarios locally and in headless CI.

What this PR adds (high level): a new quickstarts/rag-cli package containing: a slim CLI runner (node+ts entrypoint), a small local indexer example, telemetry probe shims that emit structured traces and metrics to stdout (and a test sink), a contract-lint hook that validates tool-call JSON schemas during "pre-run" and an optional smoke e2e GH workflow. The README contains step-by-step authoring and a short section on integrating the probes into Redwood Console.

Design notes: the starter is intentionally small: no heavy deps, explicit adapters for streaming vs. blocking model calls, and opt-in telemetry so teams can use it as a template for private deployments. The contract linter integrates a minimal JSON Schema check plus a deterministic sample validation harness so devs get early feedback on tool bindings.

Checklist: - [x] CLI runner and template files - [x] README + quickstart tutorial and example prompts - [x] telemetry probe stubs + test sink - [x] contract linter and example contract - [x] compact GH smoke workflow - [x] basic unit tests and CI job entries

Compatibility: works with hosted Redwood API and local dev proxies. No changes required on the serving runtime. When used with Redwood Console the probes map to the recommended telemetry fields (request_id, route, model_variant, tokens_generated).

Related work: ENG-9242 (local quickstart initiative), similar in intent to earlier shellless and authoring kits but focuses on tiny CLI-first loop and explicit contract validation. Links: Linear ENG-9242, PRs: #824761 (simulated tool assertion harness) referenced for test patterns.

How to try locally: 1) git clone && cd quickstarts/rag-cli 2) yarn && yarn dev --prompt "Explain Redwood billing model" 3) yarn smoke to run the compact e2e that runs an indexer, a single retrieval, and validates tool-call contract samples.

Notes for reviewers: I kept diffs small and split most implementation pieces into separate commits. The telemetry probe format is intentionally minimal; if we want to standardize field names further we can follow up with a smaller PR to align with telemetry-presets.

Merge outcome: squash-merged after CI flakiness reprovisioned and e2e smoke re-ran.
